description: High-value customer segment with cumulative order spend of $500 or more, or 5 or more orders.
overview: A key metric for measuring customer loyalty, filtering the top segment by combining average order value and purchase frequency. Serves as the primary criteria for exclusive promotions and differentiated tier benefits.

sql_mapping.condition: id IN (SELECT user_id FROM thelook_ecommerce.order_items GROUP BY user_id HAVING SUM(sale_price) >= 500 OR COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) >= 5)

description: The initial marketing channel through which a customer accessed the website.
overview: Identifies which marketing touchpoint (search, ads, email, etc.) brought the user at the time of registration or first order. Used for attribution analysis of new customer acquisition.

description: Inactive customer group with no purchase history in the last 90 days.
overview: Customers defined as churned because the elapsed time since their last order exceeds the benchmark threshold. Primary target for win-back and retargeting email campaigns.

sql_mapping.condition: id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM thelook_ecommerce.orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY))

description: New members who created an account within the last 30 days.
overview: Cohort used when planning welcome coupons or onboarding campaigns to drive initial purchase conversion for newly registered members.

description: Percentage of sessions where items were added to the cart but did not lead to a completed purchase.
overview: Calculates the proportion of web log event sessions containing a "cart" event that lack a corresponding "purchase" completion event, used as a UI/UX optimization metric.

sql_mapping.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Cart' AND session_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM thelook_ecommerce.events WHERE event_type = 'Purchase') THEN session_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Cart' THEN session_id END) * 100

description: Ratio of product profit margin relative to product retail selling price.
overview: The proportion of selling price represented by retail price minus cost. Serves as a performance metric for product sourcing and a benchmark for marginal pricing in discount campaigns.

description: Physical logistics facility where products are initially received, packed, and dispatched for delivery.
overview: Global distribution warehouses operated by TheLook eCommerce where product inventory is stored. Contains latitude/longitude coordinates to serve as origin points for shipping distance calculations.

description: Order items that were returned by customers after delivery or cancelled prior to delivery completion.
overview: Transactions where order delivery status is confirmed as "Returned" or "Cancelled". Essential for anomaly detection and return logistics cost estimation.

description: Number of days from the actual ship date of an order item until delivery is completed to the customer.
overview: Monitors regional shipping delays and courier performance by calculating average elapsed days between ship timestamp (shipped_at) and delivery timestamp (delivered_at).

description: Proportion of total completed order items that were cancelled or returned.
overview: Proportion of ordered items refunded due to customer change of mind or defects, used to assess brand/category quality and customer service logistics workload.
